podcast.title: Iconic Vancouver Hardcore Band
podcast.body: Adversity is recognized as a prominent band from Vancouver's 70s and 80s hardcore scene, which was a defining musical characteristic of the city during that era. Matthew Good referenced them while discussing the loss of Vancouver's influential musical "edge." "I can't see no means no or DOA or adversity or anyone doing that."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Matt Good: In His Own Words - Part 2

xref.title: Overcoming Adversity
xref.body: The release of "Mother's Milk" in 1989 came after a few difficult years for the band, including the tragic death of guitarist Hillel Slovak due to a heroin overdose and a series of unsuccessful drummers. "It had come after a few years with guitarist Hilaal Slovak dying of a heroin overdose and a succession of drummers that didn't work out."
